name: magelift-configure
description: Configure a MageLift PHP project and choose Magento services. Use when selecting PHP, database, search, queue, cache, Varnish, edge, or provider options.

name: magelift-dependencies
description: Check the local tools MageLift needs for Docker, cloud access, builds, and imported database dumps. Use when doctor reports a missing or unreachable tool.

name: magelift-local-runtime
description: Create and operate MageLift's local Magento Docker environment with the release-specific PHP, Composer, database, cache, search, and queue contract. Use when starting local development or checking a local compatibility gap.

name: magelift-migrate
description: Import Magento settings from Adobe Commerce Cloud, Upsun, Platform.sh or Compose and rehearse a migration to AWS, GCP or Azure.

name: magelift-operate
description: Operate a MageLift environment after deployment. Use for status, health, logs, safe Magento commands, release promotion, rollback, and teardown.
